limits: No general rounding-mode enum argument; named functions and rounded bool only.
Codec has no input_present/file-presence or framed record-stream API; null/nonbytes record rejection is not missing-file behavior.
No external packed codec or trailing separate sign support; S14/S15 measurements pending.
COMPUTE exact rational intermediary and SIZE ERROR/negative-zero/MOVE magnitude semantics remain compiler-unverified.
String-operation/native typed input domain is finite; invalid unhashable op objects not exercised and no all-type refusal guarantee claimed.
Only exact reviewed current shim/codec unit tests may use designated read-only3.12.13; finite pass is not full product/compiler/model/containment/independence/P2 validation.
